name: t5x-sdrift-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is T5X, a JAX and Flax library for training, evaluating and running inference
with sequence models: model and decoding code, partitioning, optimizers, training state, checkpointing,
metrics and the gin-configured train, eval and infer binaries.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the core T5X library: every top-level module of the t5x/ package (t5x/*.py) except the tests (t5x/*_test.py), the test helpers t5x/test_utils.py and t5x/assert_gc_disabled_during_import_test_util.py, and t5x/tasks.py, t5x/precompile.py, t5x/export.py and t5x/export_lib.py; together with the pages README.md, docs/index.md, docs/index.rst, docs/overview.md, every usage guide under docs/usage/ except docs/usage/gpu-usage.md, and every API reference page under docs/api_reference/ except docs/api_reference/t5x.test_utils.rst, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting
evidence, and when a comment conflicts with the documentation, follow the documentation.

The environment runs Python 3.12 on CPU only (no TPU or G
